title: About
text: I work in financial management and budgetary reporting at the European Medicines Agency in Amsterdam. My background is finance and portfolio management (MSc, Tor Vergata), and my day to day is making financial data flow without human glue: SQL pipelines, Databricks, Python, Power BI.

title: About
text:
How I work
Lead with the problem. Most of my tools started as an Excel file someone updated by hand, again and again. I map the manual steps first, then rebuild only the parts where automation pays for itself. I document everything, because a tool nobody else can run is a liability, not an asset.

title: About
text:
Off the clock
Crime novels, long evening runs, and videogames. I hold a World Champion title in BTD2, which I mention because it is true and because nobody believes it at first.
